_meta.description: GridGap — ADMIE/RAAEY transmission-saturation zones for RES connection, compiled 2026-07-11 from primary sources (raaey.gr, admie.gr, deddie.gr) + DEDDIE saturated-networks map.
_meta.confidence: Only Peloponnese + Evia are formally, citably saturated for the interconnected system (ΡΑΕ decisions + ΦΕΚ). CONFIRMED 2026-07 via primary-source research: NO Article-14 (Ν.4685/2020) κορεσμένο-δίκτυο characterization decision exists for any of the 7 mainland north/central regions below. Their saturation is real operationally but documented only as exhausted electrical space (ηλεκτρικός χώρος) in the ΑΔΜΗΕ ΔΠΑ 2025-2034 and the ΔΕΔΔΗΕ κορεσμένα-δίκτυα map, plus connection-offer freezes / priority KYAs (ΥΠΕΝ/ΓΔΕ/84014/7123 ΦΕΚ Β' 4333/2022; ΦΕΚ 4918/Β/2024). So they stay 'indicative', NOT citable. The annual Article-14 absorption-margin decisions that do exist (E-74/2023, ΦΕΚ Β' 4668) cover the non-interconnected islands (ΜΔΝ) only.
caveats: The 630 MW (W. Macedonia) / 605 MW (Thessaly) figures are POTENTIAL capacities from a May-2025 ΜΔΝ consultation, NOT current interconnected-system releases.
Cyclades/Crete are under phased interconnection — margin being released, not a standing saturation declaration.
Evia characterization = ΡΑΕ 136/2006 & 96/2007; margins ΡΑΕ 1253/2010, 1291/2011 (decision numbers confirmed; exact ΦΕΚ numbers still unconfirmed). Peloponnese ΡΑΕ 699/2012, 231/2022 ΦΕΚ unconfirmed.

The 'no Article-14 decision' finding is strong but not exhaustively machine-verified against every Διαύγεια record (Diavgeia full-text API timed out). Belt-and-suspenders: a Διαύγεια full-text query on ΡΑΑΕΥ for 'κορεσμ' 2023-2025.
